center.locator: Midpoint of the Soudan Mine shaft house (OSM way/722791010) and the MINOS paper's Level 27 coordinate
center.note: Map centre only; not a claim about any structure.

levels.name: Surface
levels.note: Soudan, Minnesota; the historic Soudan Mine shaft house (Lake Vermilion-Soudan Underground Mine State Park).

depth_m.quote: The detector is housed in a specially excavated cavern, 705 m underground (2070 meters-water-equivalent)

levels.name: Level 27 (705 m)
levels.note: Plan view; houses the surveyed MINOS far-detector midpoint (geometry:soudan-minos-far-detector-point) and the derived steel-plane envelope of the detector (geometry:soudan-minos-far-detector-footprint, axis 333.4452°). CDMS II and SuperCDMS Soudan share the site record; the laboratory shaft is inclined 12° from vertical (arXiv:0805.3170 Sec. 6.4.1).

name: Soudan Underground Laboratory, Soudan, Minnesota
notes: Release geometry (underground): the surveyed detector midpoint was refined to six decimals with 3 m accuracy and the detector's steel-plane envelope was added from the published axis azimuth and dimensions. The cavern itself is not drawn.

summary.plain: The Soudan iron mine in northern Minnesota, with the historic shaft house at the surface and, 705 m down on the 27th level, the MINOS far detector drawn at its surveyed position and orientation. The cavern and the neighbouring dark-matter laboratory are not located.
summary.technical: Surveyed MINOS far-detector midpoint (arXiv:0805.3170, 0.7 m inertial survey precision), derived 8 m x 30.3 m steel-plane envelope along the published 333.4452° axis, OSM shaft house and Shaft #8; cavern and CDMS laboratory unlocated.

unlocated.backlog: The MINOS TDR (NuMI-L-337) or a Soudan lab level-27 plan giving the cavern dimensions and the offset between the MINOS and Soudan 2 / CDMS caverns; with the published axis azimuth the MINOS hall can be drawn as a rectangle about the surveyed midpoint, and the neighbouring cavern placed from the stated offset.
unlocated.reason: The cavern that houses MINOS and the neighbouring Soudan laboratory (the former Soudan 2 cavern, CDMS II, SuperCDMS Soudan) are named in the MINOS paper ('the MINOS detector hall and the neighboring Soudan laboratory') but their sizes and positions relative to the surveyed detector midpoint are not given in any fetched source: the paper states only the detector/cavern axis azimuth. The MINOS Technical Design Report (OSTI 1861363; Fermilab archive) and the University of Minnesota laboratory site, which may carry cavern dimensions and a level plan, were unreachable (HTTP 403 and connection refused).
